import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']

# Group ALL trips by DOY, regardless of season
doy_analysis = trips.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'fished_date_season': 'nunique'
}).round(2)
doy_analysis.columns = ['yt_total', 'trips_count', 'yt_per_trip', 'num_seasons']
doy_analysis = doy_analysis[doy_analysis['trips_count'] >= 5]  # Only DOYs with enough data
doy_analysis = doy_analysis.sort_values('yt_per_trip', ascending=False)

print("=== Top 20 DOYs by average YT per trip (min 5 trips) ===")
print(doy_analysis.head(20))

print("\n=== Fall peak (DOY 287-297) detailed breakdown ===")
fall_peak = trips[(trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 287) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 297)]
fall_by_doy = fall_peak.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'fished_date_season': 'nunique'
}).round(2)
fall_by_doy.columns = ['yt_total', 'trips', 'yt_per_trip', 'seasons']
print(fall_by_doy.sort_index())
